purpose: Defines the evaluation runner CLI, declarative matrix executor, OpenTelemetry (OTel) and Parquet exporters, and GitHub Actions CI quality-gating workflows for Prism.
scope: Covers crates/prism-cli: prism test, prism bench, prism matrix, prism record, prism.matrix.toml parser, OTel OTLP v1.28+ exporter, Apache Parquet sink, and GitHub Step Summary rendering.
non_goals: Interactive GUI or web server rendering (CLI-first architecture).

api_surface.name: Cli
api_surface.signature: pub struct Cli { pub command: Commands, pub json: bool, pub offline: bool, pub github_summary: bool }
api_surface.description: Top-level command line argument parser for prism with test, bench, matrix, and record subcommands.
error_conditions: Exits with code 2 on invalid command syntax

api_surface.name: MatrixRunner
api_surface.signature: pub struct MatrixRunner; impl MatrixRunner { pub async fn run_matrix(path: &Path) -> Result<MatrixComparisonReport, CliError>; }
api_surface.description: Executes Cartesian evaluation experiments across models, prompts, and harnesses with rate-limited concurrency.

api_surface.name: TelemetryExporter
api_surface.signature: pub trait TelemetryExporter: Send + Sync { fn name(&self) -> &'static str; fn export_trial(&self, result: &MatrixResultDatum, transcript: &CanonicalTranscript) -> Result<(), ExportError>; fn flush(&self) -> Result<(), ExportError>; }
api_surface.description: Pluggable telemetry interface implemented by OtelOtlpExporter, ParquetExporter, and GitHubStepSummaryExporter.

api_surface.name: render_github_summary
api_surface.description: Generates a clean, scannable GitHub Step Summary Markdown report for CI runs with transparent API token cost labeling.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: WHEN prism test is executed with --offline, THE SYSTEM SHALL run all matching test suites against local fixtures in under 50 milliseconds with $0.00 network spend.
WHEN all task assertions pass in prism test, THE SYSTEM SHALL exit with status code 0.
IF any task assertion fails in prism test, THE SYSTEM SHALL exit with status code 1 and render a miette diagnostic card detailing the failed assertion.
WHEN --github-summary is passed in GitHub Actions, THE SYSTEM SHALL append the formatted evaluation scorecard Markdown directly to the file at GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY.
WHEN prism bench --skill=<SKILL> is invoked, THE SYSTEM SHALL execute paired trials against baseline models and output the delta in pass rate, token cost, and turns.
WHEN prism matrix run <FILE.toml> is invoked, THE SYSTEM SHALL execute the Cartesian matrix across declared models and harnesses, computing data-vs-data differentials.
WHEN reporting financial economics, THE SYSTEM SHALL explicitly label commercial API runs as 'API Token Cost ($ USD)' and local/on-prem runs as '$0.00 (API Token Fees) / Self-Hosted'.

reasoning: Defines the evaluation CLI runner, declarative matrix execution, pluggable OTel/Parquet exporters, and transparent economic reporting.
